name: Spinner
description: Indeterminate loading indicator with accessible status semantics.
designIntent: Communicate in-progress states without layout shift; inherit text color so it adapts to any context.

props.name: label
props.description: Screen-reader label; the visual ring is aria-hidden.

antiPatterns.title: Do not use multiple spinners for one wait state
antiPatterns.explanation: One status indicator per operation; multiple role=status elements announce redundantly.

accessibility.implementation: role=status with sr-only label announces loading to screen readers.
Pair with motion-reduce utilities when animation must be suppressed.
